'''261''' ('''two hundred [and] sixty-one''') is the [[natural number]] following [[260 (number)|260]] and preceding [[262 (number)|262]].

== In Mathematics ==
There are six divisors of this number, the divisors being {{num|1}}, {{num|3}}, {{num|9}}, {{num|29}}, {{num|87}}, and 261 itself.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://numbermatics.com/n/261/|title=Facts about the number 261|work=Numbermatics - the number explorer|access-date=2017-03-20}}</ref> 261 is a [[deficient number]], since {{math|1=1 + 3 + 9 + 29 + 87 = 129 < 261.}}

261 is [[nonagonal number]],<ref>{{Cite OEIS|A001106|nonagonal number}}</ref> [[unique prime|unique period]] in [[base 2]], and the number of possible unfolded [[tesseract]] patterns.

261 is a [[lucky number]],<ref>{{Cite OEIS|A000959|lucky number}}</ref> as well as an [[odious number]], meaning it has an odd number of 1's in its [[Binary number|binary]] expansion, which is {{math|100000101<sub>2</sub>}} (with 3 ones in it).<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.numbergossip.com/261|title=Number Gossip: 261|website=www.numbergossip.com|language=en|access-date=2017-03-20}}</ref>
